name: project-review-patches
title: Project review patches
description: Use this skill only when explicitly reviewing current uncommitted work as separate, refreshable proposed commit patches. The coordinator chooses whole-file or whole-hunk boundaries; a named HCOM Scout creates and checks ignored patch artefacts without changing source, the worktree, or the index.
when: When explicitly reviewing uncommitted work as refreshable proposed commit patches
do-not-use-when: Reviewing uncommitted work without separate patch proposals — use project-review-worktree
Reviewing committed work across a Git range — use project-review-commits
Creating, staging, committing, rebasing, tagging, merging, or publishing history
